messages:
deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout: inference-service @prod -> model:v2b weights:model-weights-v2b tokenizer:tokenizer-v1.legacy canary=5%
leila: Heads up — I see garbled tokens in the canary traces, examples below. Not a normal degradation.
leila: ```
input: \"Summarize the release notes\"
output (v2b): \"Ã\");

user: what?
```
oncall-jay: Ack. Paging in. @leila can you capture 3-5 failing request ids and example spans?
leila: grabbing IDs now: req_8f3c, req_8f40, req_8f55. Logs show tokenizer mismatches (unknown token markers) and unexpected token length growth.
oncall-jay: Pause the rollout. Flip the rollout feature flag to pause traffic to v2b.
sam: How to pause? I can run the flag call if needed.
leila: Flag endpoint: `POST https://api.redwood-internal/flags/rollout/model_v2b` payload `\{\"state\":\"paused\"}`
leila: running it now...
ops-bot: Feature flag update accepted: model_v2b -> paused :rotating_light:
incident-bot: New incident created: INC-3142 (canary model mismatch), severity: high, oncall: oncall-jay
oncall-jay: Good. Next: revert canary traffic immediately to v2a and start rollback to stable weights. Use one-click rollback in deployer or run: `deploy rollback --service inference --to model-weights-v2a --reason \"canary tokenizer mismatch\"`
leila: Initiating rollback command now. Output: `rollback initiated (job 9421) — draining canary nodes, promoting v2a`
ops-bot: Rollback job 9421 status: IN_PROGRESS. Draining canary pool.
leila: Confirmed we've cut canary percentage to 0 and forced traffic back to v2a.
maya: Support: we're seeing ~12% increase in API error responses for the last 8 minutes on orgs using v2b routing. One customer (Acct ACME-42) reported garbled outputs to their users. Ticket created TKT-12345, CC'd account team.
sam: Customer impact note captured. Notify sales/customer-ops to outreach. @customer-ops please escalate per playbook.
customer-ops: On it — pinged account team, scheduled a brief call in 30m.
oncall-jay: Monitoring: error rate returning to baseline after rollback, latency stable. Keeping incident open for root cause and postmortem.
leila: Initial hypothesis: packaging step pulled wrong tokenizer alias into the model artifact (tokenizer-v1.legacy instead of tokenizer-v1.compat). Build checksum mismatch seems likely.
sam: Good catch. Add immediate guard: verify tokenizer alias checksum in CI before promoting to canary.
leila: Agreed — I'll add an additional artifact checksum check and a tokenizer smoke test in the canary stage. Owner: leila. ETA: EOD.
oncall-jay: Ops tasks: create a temporary canary smoke test job that runs random tokenization/roundtrip for each model before traffic. Ops owner: oncall-jay.
ops-bot: Rollback job 9421 status: SUCCEEDED. Traffic fully on v2a. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: INC-3142 updated: mitigation complete, collecting artifacts for postmortem.
leila: Dropping sample failing logs and package manifests into the incident thread: s3://redwood-incidents/INC-3142/artifacts.log
sam: Thanks everyone. Action items summarized: 1) Postmortem (leila) 2) CI artifact checksum + tokenizer check (leila) 3) Canary smoke test (oncall-jay) 4) Customer outreach (customer-ops/maya).
maya: I'll join postmortem prep and pull customer timelines.
oncall-jay: Closing notes: no broad customer outage after rollback, single-account user-visible impact confirmed, mitigation successful. Will rotate oncall follow-ups tomorrow.
leila: Adding follow-up: audit release packaging pipeline for alias resolution bug.
sam: Great. Marking incident as mitigated; keep incident open for writeup. :memo:
